name: Tazan's Satchel
summary: Near Ratchet, Tazan faces pirates along the coast with a locked satchel in hand. The Shattered Hand wants the intelligence within.

sections.title: Secrets of the Barrens
sections.body: Near Ratchet, Tazan deals with pirates camped along the Barrens coast. Therzok, a guild master of the Shattered Hand beneath Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow, has taken notice. The guild seeks power in secret beyond Warchief Thrall's cautious diplomacy. It has marked Tazan for elimination to seize the intelligence in his satchel.

sections.title: A Complex Lock
sections.body: The satchel's lock is difficult to open in the field. Tazan gave the key to Gamon, his associate, who drinks in an Orgrimmar tavern. Rogues who seek the satchel must lift the key from Gamon's pocket without raising an alarm. Then they can read Tazan's logbook.

faq.q: Who does this satchel belong to?
faq.answer: Tazan, a troll who deals with pirates near Ratchet in the Barrens, carries the satchel.

faq.q: Why does the Shattered Hand want Tazan's Satchel?
faq.answer: Therzok and the Shattered Hand seek intelligence from Tazan's dealings with coastal pirates. They hope to expand their network and reclaim martial pride from the shadows.

faq.q: Where is the key to open the satchel?
faq.answer: Tazan left the key with his associate Gamon, a drunken patron in an Orgrimmar tavern.
Tazan's logbook lies inside the locked satchel. It details his secret trades and ties to coastal buccaneers.

angles.text: As a Horde rogue, you must recover the satchel and lift its key from Gamon to earn your place in the Shattered Hand.
In Orgrimmar, the Shattered Hand seeks covert advantage while Warchief Thrall pursues a more measured course.
